en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5296 - It is narrated by Asim ibn Humaid from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a tooth or an arm that is intentionally broken - does it require compensation (financial payment) or is there retaliation (qisas)?
Imam (as) replied: "Retaliation (qisas)."

I asked: "What if they offer him blood money instead?"
Imam (as) replied: "If he is satisfied with whatever they offer, then it is permissible for him."
